## 💡 07 · WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW

- The EXP rate on the Golden Mattock is low (5.00%, 50.00% on Normal) — Golden is **item-focused**, Normal gives more EXP
- There is **no EXP** on the Platinum Auto Mining list — all 21 entries are items; Automatic Mining Gift Box (0.05%) only here
- If you don't know where an item comes from: **Ctrl + D** on the item
- All rates: in game **Guide → Mining & Fishing** or sexyko.com/guide/mining-fishing
